typography.glyphCoverage: Checked with fontTools against public/fonts/big-shoulders-display-latin-{800,900}-normal.woff2. It has Ä Ö Ü ä ö ü ß „ “ ‚ ‘ ’ – — · × € §. It has no capital ẞ (U+1E9E), so never type ẞ. Let CSS text-transform: uppercase turn ß into SS (GRÖSSE) with lang="de" on <html>.
typography.lengthExpansion: German H1s range from 11 characters shorter to 6 longer than the English ones (because 'herunterladen' replaces 'Downloader'), so total length is not the problem. Long single words are. The longest, HERUNTERLADEN, measures 277px at the 46px phone H1 size (343px column). At the 60px tablet/desktop size it is 362px, which fits the ≥472px desktop copy column. No H1 segment overflows (validated per page). Most H1s wrap to 2 lines on a 375px phone, the guides to 3, and 'Pinterest-Video auf iPhone & Android herunterladen' to 4 (~166px). Keep that page's lede short so the ticket stays in the first viewport.
typography.breaking: Use explicit hyphens in compounds so display lines can break after them (PINTEREST- / PROFILBILD). Don't use hyphens:auto on the uppercase display face. Body text should use hyphens:auto with lang=de. Use ­ only if a closed compound over ~14 letters ever reaches an H1.
typography.umlautClearance: Display line-height is 0.88–0.9. Umlaut dots on caps (FÜR, GRÖSSE, ÖFFENTLICHER) sit above the cap height and could touch the line above or be clipped by overflow:hidden. Check visually on 'Pinterest-Downloader für Chrome' and the label strip. A de-only line-height of 0.92 is enough if they touch.

productBugFoundDuringResearch.summary: Austrian and Swiss desktop links are rejected by /api/extract.
productBugFoundDuringResearch.detail: www.pinterest.at and www.pinterest.ch 308-redirect to at.pinterest.com and ch.pinterest.com (checked with curl). The isPinterestUrl regex in src/pages/api/extract.ts (line ~1104, read in the working tree) only allows the subdomains www|in|uk|br|id|jp|de|fr|es|it|ca|au. Tested with node: https://at.pinterest.com/pin/123/ → false, https://ch.pinterest.com/pin/123/ → false, while de.pinterest.com and www.pinterest.at pass. The client-side classifyPinterestInput accepts any 'pinterest.' host, so users get past the ticket and then hit an 'Invalid link' void.
productBugFoundDuringResearch.impact: Desktop users in AT/CH who copy the address bar (the method the board, profile and PC pages teach) fail. pin.it app links are unaffected. Other locales have the same problem (nl., pl., ru., se., mx., …).
productBugFoundDuringResearch.fix: Accept any two-letter or www subdomain, e.g. /^https?:\/\/([a-z]{2}\.|www\.)?(pinterest\.[a-z.]+|pin\.it)\//i. Coordinate with the mcp-server branch, which is moving this code into a shared module.

notes.legalRisk: German-language pages aimed at DE/AT/CH bring the site under German/Austrian Impressum rules (DDG §5 / ECG §5, MedienG) once it is monetised, and make a German-language Datenschutzerklärung and a cookie-consent banner for ads (TDDDG) expected. Missing ones are a common 'Abmahnung' target in Germany. Flag this to the owner before launch. This is not legal advice.
